nuggets.text: Warhawks coach Bryant Vincent was UAB's interim head coach in 2022 and led the Blazers to a Bahamas Bowl win.
Saturday is a Birmingham homecoming for six Warhawks staff members and two players who have UAB ties.
Warhawks coach Bryant Vincent went to West Alabama to play baseball before joining its football program as a student assistant.
The Warhawks' program won the 1987 Division I-AA title, rallying from 42-28 down in the fourth quarter to beat Marshall 43-42.
The Warhawks knocked off No. 8 Arkansas 34-31 in overtime in 2012.
James Malone, honored with a new installation at the Warhawks' stadium, also coached basketball, boxing, baseball and track.
Doug Pederson, who coached the Eagles to their first Super Bowl title, played quarterback for the Warhawks' program from 1987 to 1990.
Warhawks kicker Abram Murray hit a career-long 52-yard field goal at Mississippi State, the team's first 52-yarder since 2021.
The Warhawks beat UAB 32-6 in 2024 and lead the all-time series 2-1.
